title: Module Group1 — Procedure Identification
description:
The shared Procedure Identification block, composed into all 16 TAPPs in the 2026-08-11 library (Claude Skills for TAPP/modules/Module_Group1.csv, v3). Seventeen fields, all Keyed By "(none)", every one of which maps to a property that already exists on tappDefinition or adaProduct rather than to a new ada: property. So this module is a PROFILE, not a set of definitions: it asserts which base properties a conforming procedure or analysis carries, and which are required.
Requiredness is derived from the module's two tier columns, per the TAPP tier matrix:

  Procedure-Level Basic    -> required in ProcedureIdentification
  Procedure-Level Advanced -> permitted, not required
  Procedure-Level N/A      -> absent from the procedure entirely; analysis-level only
  Analysis-Level Basic     -> required in AnalysisIdentification (supplied fresh per analysis)
  Analysis-Level Advanced  -> permitted, not required
  Analysis-Level Read-Only / Editable -> inherited from the procedure, so not required again

The two $defs exist because the procedure and the analysis are separate documents in this repo: a TAPP schema composes ProcedureIdentification, a technique detail schema composes AnalysisIdentification. Splitting here keeps the module the single source for both.
Field-to-path mappings were taken from the nine schema-path sidecars, where all seventeen agree unanimously -- which is the evidence that this block really is shared rather than coincidentally similar. Column F (Example / Allowed Content) is consumer-owned per the module manifest, so no enum is pinned here; a consuming TAPP may narrow a value space, never widen it.

ProcedureIdentification.title: Group1 fields that live on the procedure
ProcedureIdentification.description: Composed into a TAPP (prov:Plan) schema. The five required properties are the module's Procedure-Level Basic fields: Procedure Name, Technique, Procedure Author, Laboratory and Procedure Start Date.

AnalysisIdentification.title: Group1 fields that live on the analysis
AnalysisIdentification.description: Composed into a technique detail (schema:Dataset) schema. The required properties are the module's Analysis-Level Basic fields -- values that cannot be known until the analysis runs: Procedure DOI, Analyst, Session Identifier, Analysis Start Date, Analysis End Date and Funding Source for Analysis. Coupled Procedure DOI and Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference are Analysis-Level Advanced and therefore optional.
